findings.description: The new sentence "The restored set is per repository: the workflow's `RESTORE_PATHS` names it..." reads as scoping the whole ten-path restored set (enumerated in the sentence immediately before it: `.claude/`, `.mcp.json`, `.claude.json`, `.gitmodules`, `.ripgreprc`, `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `.husky`, plus `AGENTS.md`/`.agents/`) to `RESTORE_PATHS`, but `RESTORE_PATHS` (confirmed `AGENTS.md .agents templates` in this repo's rendered workflow) only names the second, workflow-step-driven group — the first eight paths are a fixed list baked into `claude-code-action` itself, not configurable per repo. `docs/design/0001-architecture.md` (~line 436-447) draws this exact split more precisely: "The list is the workflow's RESTORE_PATHS" refers only to the extension beyond the action's own fixed restore. A validator confirmed the imprecision is real but downgraded from important to nit: the bullet's own preceding sentence already spells out the full ten-path list by name, so an orchestrator reading the whole bullet (not just this clause) still has the complete picture, making the misread unlikely to actually cause a briefing gap in practice.

Not an issue: the new comment `// Nothing to pin: the tooling is built here, not installed from npm.` was checked against AGENTS.md's comment rule and the sibling TRANSFORMS comments and found compliant (genuine non-obvious why, matches the file's existing comment style) and accurate against HEADER's dogfooding note #1. Recorded here only as a negative confirmation, not a defect.
